name: Hummus
instructions: Rinse and drain one can of chickpeas. In a food processor, blend chickpeas with 2 tablespoons tahini, 1 minced garlic clove, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Blend until smooth. Add water for desired consistency. Season with salt.

name: Soy Beef Soup
instructions: In a pot, sauteed onions, garlic, and carrots for 5 minutes. Add soy protein chunks and stir for 2 minutes. Pour in 4 cups vegetable broth, add herbs and seasonings, then simmer for 30 minutes or until tender.

name: Tofu Broccoli Stew
instructions: Cube firm tofu and pan-fry until golden. In a pot, sauté garlic and ginger, add broccoli and cooked tofu. Pour in 3 cups of vegetable broth, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, and simmer for 15 minutes.

name: Noodle Wok
instructions: Cook noodles separately. In a hot wok, stir-fry chopped vegetables in sesame oil. Add cooked noodles, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, and a pinch of chili flakes. Toss for 3–4 minutes.

name: Vegan Mushroom Stew
instructions: Sauteed a mix of mushrooms with diced onions and garlic. Add vegetable broth, thyme, and a splash of plant-based cream. Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: Chicken with Potato
instruction: Season chicken thighs and potato wedges with olive oil, rosemary, and garlic. Roast in oven at 200°C (400°F) for 40–45 minutes, flipping halfway through.

name: Chicken with Penne Pasta
instruction: Boil penne pasta. Cook diced chicken in a pan until golden. Add cooked pasta and combine with your preferred creamy sauce (e.g., cream + parmesan). Heat through and serve.

name: Sausage with Meatballs
instruction: Fry sausages and meatballs in a pan with a splash of oil until cooked through. Serve with mashed potatoes, rice, or pasta of your choice.
ingredients: Tomato sauce or mustard for serving (optional)
Side option: mashed potatoes, rice, or vegetables

name: Avocado Toast
instruction: Toast whole grain bread. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread on toast. Optionally top with chili flakes, seeds, or egg.
ingredients: 2 slices bread of choice (sourdough, whole grain, white)
Optional toppings: chili flakes, cherry tomatoes, poached egg, microgreens

name: Pasta Bolognese
instruction: Sauté ground meat, onions, and garlic. Add tomato paste, canned tomatoes, and herbs. Simmer for 30–40 minutes. Cook pasta, combine, and serve.

name: Chickpea
instruction: Heat olive oil in a pan. Add drained chickpeas and season with cumin, paprika, and salt. Cook for 10 minutes until golden and fragrant. Serve warm or cold as a side or salad topping.

name: Couscous with Carrot and Tomatoes
instruction: Prepare couscous with boiling water and let it steam. Meanwhile, sauté chopped carrots and tomatoes in olive oil. Mix vegetables into couscous and season with herbs and salt.

name: Rice and Chickpea
instruction: Cook rice according to package instructions. Stir in canned or pre-cooked chickpeas, olive oil, and spices like turmeric and garlic powder. Mix and serve.

name: Plant Based Mix
instruction: Combine cooked tofu, black beans, corn, and sautéed vegetables in a bowl. Season with chili powder, lime juice, and salt. Serve warm or cold.

name: Couscous, Chickpea, and Grilled Tomato
instruction: Grill halved tomatoes in a pan. Cook couscous with boiling water and mix with chickpeas. Combine everything and season with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

name: Aubergine Stew with Rice
instruction: Sauté chopped aubergines with onion and garlic until soft. Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 25 minutes. Serve over freshly cooked rice.

name: Fried Fish with Potato
instruction: Season fish fillets and coat lightly with flour. Fry in oil until golden. Boil or roast potatoes with herbs and olive oil. Serve together.

name: Fried Cod with Rice
instruction: Fry seasoned cod fillets until crispy. Steam rice and serve with sautéed vegetables on the side.

name: Salmon with Mashed Potato
instruction: Pan-sear or bake salmon fillet. Boil potatoes, then mash with a bit of butter and milk. Season and serve.

name: Salmon with Boiled Potato
instruction: Bake or pan-fry salmon with herbs. Boil potatoes and season with a bit of olive oil and parsley. Serve with a side salad.

name: Cod with Couscous
instruction: Steam or pan-fry cod fillets. Prepare couscous and toss with chopped vegetables and herbs. Serve the fish over couscous.
